タイトル: Solid cloud phone but needs polish

良い点: Super easy to set up and integrates perfectly with Zoom Meetings – everything's in one app. Call quality is generally clear, and I love the voicemail transcription and call recording features. The mobile app works great too, so I can take work calls anywhere. Admin dashboard is simple to manage users and numbers, and the pricing is competitive for what you get.
改善点: The call quality can get spotty when internet is unstable, and there's no fallback to cellular, which is frustrating during important calls. International calling rates are expensive, and SMS is limited compared to competitors. Also, basic features like call parking and busy lamp fields aren't as smooth as traditional phone systems, which annoys power users.

良い点: Zoom Phone has been a reliable and user-friendly business phone solution. The integration with the broader Zoom platform makes it easy to manage calls, voicemail, messaging, and meetings from a single interface. Call quality is consistently strong, and features such as call queues, auto attendants, call recording, and voicemail transcription help improve efficiency in a busy customer service environment. The administrative tools are straightforward, making it easy to manage users and phone settings across teams.
改善点: While the platform is easy to use overall, some advanced administrative settings can require additional training to fully understand. Reporting and analytics are functional but could offer more customization and detailed insights. At times, navigating between phone, chat, and meeting settings can be slightly confusing for new users.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 病院、ヘルスケア, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Reliable and Improvable"
良い点: Alright, what I really love about Zoom Phone is its easiness to use. Yeah, it integrates perfectly with the rest of the Zoom features... so I don’t have to switch between different apps all the time. I can easily make calls right away on the go (something great when I'm running around between classes or study sessions). The call quality is also really clear; communicating with professors, classmates, and even patients is made so much easier.
改善点: One thing I don’t like about Zoom Phone is that sometimes it can be a bit unreliable, especially if I’m switching between my laptop and phone during a call. There have been a few instances where I’ve had trouble reconnecting, and it can be frustrating, especially when I’m trying to discuss something urgent with a colleague or professor. Also, if my internet connection isn’t strong enough, the call quality drops, and it’s hard to hear clearly. That’s something I’ve run into a few times, and it can be annoying when I’m in the middle of a study session or discussing a clinical case. I also wish there were more options for customizing notifications because I’ve missed calls occasionally, especially if I’m in a lecture or study group and don’t hear the alert. Despite these small hiccups, it’s still a really helpful tool, but these are the main things I think could be improved.

改善点: I really don't have nay complaints about this particular software program at this time.

投稿者: Cory 日本のTeacher 教育管理, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Zoom phone honest review"
良い点: The functionality in it's own right is clever. It is easy to use for anyone. Even thoughs who are not so tech savvy (like myself).
改善点: There are so many delys in the feed. I do live in a rural area though. I am sure that is at least partly the cause.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "avis sur zoom"
良い点: Ce logiciel est très utile en ce moment de pandémie. Je l'utilise dans mes cours mais aussi pour parler à mon entourage. Cette application est parfait pour faire des réunions de famille puisque nous pouvons être plusieurs à la fois. Et puis à l'école aussi nous l'utilisons et les professeurs trouve que cela les aide beaucoup pour enseigner. Aussi ce que j'aime de ce logiciel c'est qu'il indique quelle personne qui parle à l'aide d'un encadrer jaune, cela est très utile pour les appels de groupe.
改善点: L'un des points faibles est qu'il est parfois plus complexe de ce connecter pour des gens qui ne sont pas très a l'aise avec la technologie, cela peut être difficile. Et j'ai eu quelques difficulté avec le son.

投稿者: Lucimar ブラジルのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 美術、工芸, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "The best for meeting"
良い点: Great for video calls, meetings, the app has 40 free minutes per meeting, if you need more time you need to buy, more is a good amount per meeting, the call quality is excellent in the free version. Can be used on smarthphone and computer.
改善点: I have nothing against the application it has met all expectations sometimes I use the paid version and also the free version.
